title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1996 9.6.3 The above data reflects that the incidence of cases reported under 'Robbery', 'Arson' and 'PCR Act' showed declining trend. The maximum reduction (30.9%) in cases in 1996 was observed to be under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities Act) wherein only 9,620 cases were booked in 1996 as against 13,925 cases in the previous year. On the other hand 'Kidnapping & Abduction' cases and 'Rape' reported increasing trend. The incidence of Dacoity cases registered a sharp rise of 28.6 per cent during the year.
